chart.must_change_body: This temporary password worked. Set a password only you know before continuing.
chart.password_rules: Use at least 8 characters and enter the same password twice.
chart.password_failed: Could not save the new password.
chart.guest_access_body: We also emailed this password. It stops working after you sign in or join the visit, and you will be asked to change it.

hospital: Confirm patient identity against the MediConnect patient ID
Read the doctor’s message and what the patient reported in the consult
Complete only the tests or procedures listed on this packet
Record results on this same packet and send them back to the referring doctor
Do not send the patient to a pharmacy until the referring doctor reviews the results
pharmacy: Confirm patient identity against the MediConnect patient ID
Check allergies and current medicines before dispensing
Dispense only what the doctor wrote on this packet / prescription
Counsel on dose, duration and side effects
Mark the packet as dispensed in MediConnect when complete

inbox.doctor_step_open: Your doctor still has this step open.
inbox.pharmacy_dispensed: The pharmacy marked this dispensed. Your doctor has the reply.
inbox.step_done: This step is done. Your doctor has the update.
inbox.reply_sent: Reply sent to the referring doctor.
inbox.facility_notes: Results and findings for the referring doctor
inbox.review_keeps_episode: An uploaded result does not close the episode by itself.
inbox.send_pharmacy: Send this patient to a registered pharmacy
inbox.review_help: The facility uploaded results. Document your interpretation and next management decision. This does not mark the pharmacy as served.
inbox.review_saved: Review saved. The episode stays open only if another clinical task is still needed.
inbox.referrals_pharmacy: Patients directed here with a prescription
inbox.referrals_facility: Patients referred to this clinic or hospital
inbox.empty: When a doctor sends labs, imaging, procedures or a medicine packet, it appears here with the patient identity and protocol.
